prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: portrait 4:5 lifestyle photograph for the "Learning something new" card on a premium neurotechnology earbuds website.
Input images: Image 1 is the existing music scene to replace: preserve its believable home setting, daylight and understated editorial photographic character, but replace the instrument activity completely. Image 2 is a companion study-card photograph for natural materials and realism. Image 3 is the exact CYMBA earbud product design reference.
Primary request: replace the music practice scene with a colourful painting-in-progress in a quiet home art corner.
Scene: a pale wooden painting table beside a sunlit window, off-white plaster wall, modest houseplant at the edge. A small canvas propped on a tabletop easel is the main focal point. The canvas shows a beautiful expressive colour study of a Mediterranean coastal landscape with vivid cobalt and turquoise water, coral and warm pink buildings, ochre sunlight and lavender shadows, painted with convincing imperfect brush strokes. The artwork is clearly handmade paint on canvas, not a photograph or a digital print. Canvas fills roughly the upper half of the composition, large enough to read as colourful art at small card size. On the table below, a used palette with small mixed daubs in the same colours, two paintbrushes and a water jar; restrained naturally used arrangement, not clutter or a pristine staged flatlay.
Product: a single pair of very small CYMBA earbuds resting on a clean area of the near table, with loose thin black braided cables. Precisely match reference 3: round satin graphite outer faceplates, narrow champagne metallic rims, smoky dark compact inner bodies, small soft black fins, grey silicone ear tips. Real-world in-ear size: each earpiece body about 2 cm, clearly much smaller than a paintbrush handle; subtle supporting detail, not the main subject. Believable contact shadows and scale.
Photography: real editorial interior still life, softly directional natural window light, restrained realistic contrast, rich but natural colour in the canvas and paint, subtle surface grain and ordinary imperfections, moderate depth of field so canvas and earbuds are recognisable. Slightly oblique view into the scene, not overhead. Full bleed rectangular image, no rounded corners baked in.
Avoid: musical instruments, sheet music, people, hands, writing, branding, logos, watermark, neon glow, over-saturated room, airbrushed CGI, artificial product spotlight, oversized earbuds.
